title: 5-Hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) synthesis in a deep eutectic solvent-based biphasic system: closing the loop of solvent reuse, product isolation and green metrics
content:

The scale up and recycling of all process streams in the H4SiW12O40 catalyzed dehydration of D-fructose (Fru) to 5-hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) were investigated.
